_evidence: 0x00542224 bubble-sorts the pointer table at 0x830b0c by the signed dword +0x10 of each record (count = [0x830b04]; 'sub ecx,1; jle' exits for counts <= 1 including negative ones). 0x5420a8 builds this table: count = [0x830bac] clamped to 0x28, entries = 0x830bb4 + k*0x20 (the 40 datalog channel records of 0x20 bytes, 0x537f33 copies them in). So the count is drawn from 0..40 (plus -1 and 0x80000000 for the jle flags), every entry 0..39 is one of the 40 record addresses (in any order, repeats only make equal keys), and the keys +0x10 (0x830bc4 + k*0x20) are drawn from a small signed set with duplicates and the extremes, so sorted, unsorted, equal-key and multi-pass cases all occur. At most 40 passes of 39 compares: no timeout, and every pointer read is a fixed record.
